prior_feature_dependencies.actual_prior_description: For assigned accusative-object verbs, present or preterite wesan/bēon or weorðan + past participle expresses passive. Finite auxiliary agrees with the nominative subject. Agent omitted in productive tasks; no new fram-agent rule needed. Wesan often presents state/result and weorðan event, but not an absolute contrast or one-to-one English tense mapping.
In verbal predicates a past participle may be uninflected or take strong-masculine-like endings: neuter plural dēor bunden/bundene are both licensed. Attributive agreement remains a different target.
